major_features: Interactive canvas with drag-and-drop text overlays
Real-time relative luminance mapping for gradients and images
Instant WCAG AA/AAA compliance scoring and color suggestions
candidate_ideas.name: Contrast Canvas
candidate_ideas.pain: Designers and developers often skip rigorous accessibility checks or fail compliance because current tools only support flat color-to-color comparison, leading to late-stage design refactoring or non-compliant releases.
candidate_ideas.problem: Testing WCAG accessibility contrast ratios for complex UI components like gradients, text over images, and multi-state buttons is tedious with standard single-color pickers.
candidate_ideas.solution: A local-first visual canvas where users can paste mockups, apply dynamic CSS gradients, overlay text elements, and instantly view a live, multi-point WCAG AA/AAA contrast map showing exactly which pixels fail contrast requirements.
candidate_ideas.verification: Load a mock background image, place text on top, and verify the calculated relative luminance and WCAG rating update in real-time using pure client-side mathematical algorithms.

major_features: Automated data anomaly detection (e.g., date formats, casing, spacing)
Interactive batch transformation rules (Trim, TitleCase, DateStandardize)
100% local, serverless processing preserving data privacy
candidate_ideas.name: Tabular Tamer
candidate_ideas.pain: Users waste hours manually editing spreadsheets or trying to write brittle Excel formulas just to clean up small contact lists or transaction logs.
candidate_ideas.problem: Dirty, inconsistently formatted CSV/TSV files (mixed date formats, trailing whitespace, erratic capitalization) cause imports to fail in CRM, ERP, or marketing software.
candidate_ideas.solution: A private, client-side CSV inspector that automatically detects anomalies, offers one-click batch cleanup actions (trimming whitespace, standardizing dates to ISO, normalizing phone formats), and exports clean data without uploading anything to a server.
candidate_ideas.target_user: Small Business Owners and Data Analysts
candidate_ideas.verification: Load a malformed CSV via file input, apply standardizing rules, and verify that the download payload contains corrected data fields matching the selected rules.

major_features: Interactive visual sandbox for CSS Grid and Flexbox properties
Live responsiveness simulator with custom viewport handles
Clean, semantic HTML and CSS code exporter
candidate_ideas.name: Layout Blueprinter
candidate_ideas.pain: Developers lose productivity debugging responsive layout collapses, unexpected wrapping, and alignment bugs due to misunderstood CSS property interactions.
candidate_ideas.problem: CSS Flexbox and Grid layouts are highly abstract, leading to endless trial-and-error in browser dev tools to align elements correctly.
candidate_ideas.solution: An interactive visual builder where users configure layouts using real-time controls for Flexbox and Grid properties, visualizing item boundaries, flex-basis shrinks, and grid gaps, with instant copy-paste HTML/CSS generation.
candidate_ideas.verification: Modify properties like 'flex-grow' or 'grid-template-columns' via the UI control panel and confirm the visual layout container changes layout properties and outputs correct CSS.

major_features: Interactive railroad diagram generation for regex ASTs
Natural language translation of complex patterns and capture groups
Live test suite with match highlighting and group capturing tables
candidate_ideas.name: RegEx Visual Scribe
candidate_ideas.pain: Developers copy-paste complex regex patterns from online forums without fully understanding them, introducing bugs or security vulnerabilities like catastrophic backtracking.
candidate_ideas.problem: Regular expressions are notoriously difficult to read, debug, and document, often resulting in unmaintainable 'write-only' code.
candidate_ideas.solution: A local playground that translates any regular expression into an interactive, step-by-step visual railroad diagram and generates a plain-English explanation of each capture group, quantifier, and assertion alongside real-time match testing.
candidate_ideas.verification: Input a standard email regex pattern, verify that the visual diagram correctly maps the groups, and confirm the English explanation accurately describes the validation constraints.

major_features: Offline-first client and invoice management via browser IndexedDB
Simplified client balance tracking and payment ledger
candidate_ideas.name: Local Ledger & Invoice Designer
candidate_ideas.pain: Freelancers pay monthly fees and compromise client confidentiality just to generate a few simple invoices and track who has paid.
candidate_ideas.problem: Basic invoice creation and client balance tracking usually require expensive, privacy-invasive, and complex SaaS subscriptions.
candidate_ideas.solution: A 100% local, browser-based double-entry ledger and invoice designer. It securely stores client profiles, services, and invoice histories in browser storage (IndexedDB), and uses standard CSS print styles to generate professional, print-ready PDF invoices.
candidate_ideas.verification: Create a dummy client profile, add a service line item, save it to local storage, and trigger the browser print dialogue showing a perfectly formatted PDF layout.
